facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: near hit - pressure exposure at HX-4120

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control HYDROCARBON_TRANSFER_CONTROL: the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels was in place but did not perform, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control SEAL_FACE_TEMPERATURE_ALARM: the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip was never verified as effective, and the accident investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control SEAL_SUPPORT_SYSTEM_INTEGRITY: the integrity of the mechanical seal support system was in place but did not perform, and the accident investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Restore the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels on HX-4120 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in responding to a loss of containment, specifically isolating and depressuring a leaking system. HX-4120 (seal support coolers) is in service for barrier-fluid cooling for the hydrocarbon transfer pump family. The task proceeded during routine operation while the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels was in place but did not perform. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 3 June 2004 a near hit was recorded on HX-4120 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during routine operation; pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator was not released.
